task.name: Replace_kitchen_propane_cylinder
task.when: When 🔥 Kitchen_Propane_Supply is empty or nearly empty and the Propane Lead authorizes replacement

step.action: Confirm with the Propane Lead that the replacement cylinder and connection match the kitchen appliance.
step.ifThen: IF the size, fuel, connection, or regulator does not match, THEN do not continue.

step.action: Confirm that an appropriate extinguisher from 📦 Fire_Extinguishers is visible and accessible at the propane work area.
Extinguish every flame and remove smoking and other ignition sources from the work area.
Turn every connected kitchen appliance control to OFF.
Disconnect the regulator using the method specified by 🔥 Kitchen_Propane_Appliance_Manual.
Cap the disconnected cylinder valve with its supplied cap.
Move the disconnected cylinder upright to the propane storage area.
Place 🔥 Replacement_Kitchen_Propane_Cylinder upright in the secured operating position.
Connect the appliance regulator according to 🔥 Kitchen_Propane_Appliance_Manual.
Open the replacement cylinder valve slowly.
Apply 🔥 Propane_Leak_Test_Solution to every connection disturbed during replacement.
step.ifThen: IF growing bubbles appear, or propane is heard or smelled, THEN close the cylinder valve, keep the appliance out of service, and tell the Propane Lead.

step.action: Dampen one 🔥 Disposable_Towels towel with the minimum water needed from 🔧 Fresh_Water_Tank.
Wipe the tested connections until no leak-test solution remains.
Put the used towel in 📦 Trash_Bins.

passWhen.criterion: The matching replacement cylinder is upright, secured, and connected.
No growing bubbles, hissing, propane odor, or frost is present.
No leak-test solution or water remains on the connections or playa.
The disconnected cylinder is capped, upright, secured, and in the propane storage area.

reasoning.entry: The inspection checklist remains available to ordinary shift workers; cylinder replacement is a separate trained task.
The actual cylinder size and connection must be confirmed on playa because the workbook does not identify them.
